replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Thanks for Submitting SubDivision - here is an Update.

Here are a few things to work on if you get time. First,  I like the design of the map, it is unique!,  but we have a few problems that may have come from the port from 1.8 to 1.7.10 that are preventing us from testing. I rebuilt some of the yml in order to get the map to load, but here are a few points we found while starting to test.

  • - Map has 'ghost blocks' (blocks that are air, you used in 1.8) - these need to be replaced.
  • - Chests don't have items inside them - your items were cleaned out due to the port most likely
  • - Center of the map needs to be filled - under the center in mid is blank pretty much, just an opening under the diamond block.
  • - The regions are wrong (parts of wall don't fall, can't enter parts of own side) also player spawns are off.
  • - Quads Not rotated correctly - 
  • - Random text on signs - most likely from the port.
  • - Many holes in bedrock - not sure where this came from
  • - Water under map - streaming from the bedrock in places
The map has some YML errors, so when you rebuild the map, also redo your yml. It is hard to convert from 1.8 to 1.7.10 I have done it with and without success. It may be better to start from scratch, but that is up to you.

Thanks again, but for now we are unable to test your map.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
I like the map, but it needs a few things before we can test more. Please look at available resources. I am finding some players are having a hard time depending on only the supplied chests to get geared up. Also the hoe is over powered and needs adjusting. It may also be a good idea to add more ore etc to the map, in-case someone does want to mine. Also the Spawn hill needs to be moved back, a player can build up to it ( and jump over ) and camp there. Others will have a little chance to take them from that position as void is all around it. Please also make sure all chests have the intended items and are not blank.

Thanks again! -Please let me know when the map is updated :).
